_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_IS_STRIPED_DESCRIP: With is-striped every second row gets the background --a_table_row_striped_bg. Hover, selected rows and the open preview still have their own colors. The default for all tables can be set with AComponentsPlugin (ATable: { props: { isStriped: true } }).
_A_TABLE_COMPONENT_DESCRIPTION_: The ATable component shows data in a table with sorting, pagination, filters, quick search, row and table actions, selection of rows, a preview, hiding and moving of columns, saved views and a mobile view.
_A_TABLE_GROUP_COMPLEX_DESCRIPTION_: Row, table and multiple actions, quick search, moving of columns, pagination, footer rows, sorting by several columns and saved views in one table.
_A_TABLE_COLUMN_MULTI_ROWS_: Column Column Column Column Column Column Column Column
